proposals.evidence: DEDR 1731 full article opens “1731 (a) Ta. kuppam multitude, heap; kuppal heap, as of manure, mound, multitude; kuppai heap, mound, sweepings, rubbish, excrement, dung. Ma.…”; its Ga. (Oll.) passage gives “Ga. (Oll.) kop- to be full, (river) overflows; kope hill, forest; (S.) kuppā heap; (S. 3 ) kop- to be full; kopup- to fill ( tr. ); koppen full.”. DEDR 1731 directly prints Ollari kope “hill, forest”; it is not the homophonous wild-dog compound in DEDR 3650.
